decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm. Reanimate and Animate Dead are then used to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Daze and Brazen Borrower provide additional tempo plays and flexibility. Overall, the deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly bring powerful creatures into play.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on utilizing disruptive elements like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void to slow down opponents while quickly ramping into powerful threats like Fury and Sundering Eruption. The deck aims to control the board early on with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, leveraging its mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize. The deck also includes burn spells like Shatterskull Smashing and Broadside Bombardiers to deal direct damage and finish off opponents quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize powerful artifacts such as Basalt Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Coveted Jewel to generate mana and draw cards. By using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and The One Ring, the deck aims to create a powerful engine to generate massive mana and card advantage. The deck also includes interaction with cards like Pithing Needle and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling key pieces and overwhelming the opponent with a powerful artifact-based combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers, while disrupting opponents with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. It aims to control the game through mana denial and punishing opponents for playing non-basic lands, ultimately overwhelming them with fast and hard-hitting threats. The strategy is to quickly establish a dominant board presence and apply pressure to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. This deck is all about aggressive plays and punishing opponents for their mana base.

This deck focuses on applying pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan through hand disruption and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Nethergoyf to quickly close out games, while also using counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats. Brainstorm and Ponder help smooth out draws and find important pieces, while mana denial with Wasteland and disruption with Thoughtseize can disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently by staying ahead on board and disrupting the opponent's resources.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control over the game through countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting the opponent's strategy. It utilizes a combination of counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also contains card advantage tools like Brainstorm and Stock Up to consistently draw into relevant cards. The win condition of the deck comes from powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The main concept of this deck is to use the card "Show and Tell" to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield for free. This is done by either ramping up mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, or using cards like Ponder and Brainstorm to find the necessary combo pieces. The deck also includes protection in the form of Force of Will and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo can go off without interruption.

The key concept of this deck is to use Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bring them back onto the battlefield for a fast and powerful win condition. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Thoughtseize to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the game, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch, you can slow down your opponent's strategy. Meanwhile, creatures like Murktide Regent, Baleful Strix, and Barrowgoyf provide a clock to finish the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student also helps you filter through your deck to find the right cards. This deck aims to win quickly by disrupting your opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick and explosive win. It includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo, as well as control elements like Brazen Borrower and Force of Will to control the game. The mana base is streamlined to support the combo strategy, with a mix of fetchlands, dual lands, and Wasteland for disruption. Overall, the deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful threats and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill opponents' libraries. The deck includes support cards such as Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt for disruption, as well as cards like Goblin Engineer and Urza's Saga to search for combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Barrowgoyf and Fury provide additional threats and removal options. The deck aims to efficiently assemble and protect the combo while disrupting opponents' strategies to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into the graveyard with cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back onto the battlefield with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. The creatures, like Troll of Khazad-dûm, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, are high-impact threats that can win the game once they hit the battlefield. The deck's strategy revolves around cheating huge creatures into play and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck aims to quickly and efficiently assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to win the game. The deck contains a variety of cards to support this plan, such as Goblin Engineer, Goblin Welder, and Urza's Saga. It also includes disruption in the form of Lightning Bolt, Pyroblast, and Ensnaring Bridge to protect the combo and slow down opponent's strategies. Additionally, the deck includes some versatile utility cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Mox Opal to provide further flexibility in different situations.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of land destruction, graveyard disruption, and hand disruption. It aims to lock down the opponent's resources while setting up its own powerful land-based win conditions like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. The deck also utilizes cards like Exploration and Mox Diamond to accelerate its mana production and maintain a strong board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Crop Rotation and Life from the Loam adds flexibility and consistency to the deck's strategy. Ultimately, the deck seeks to outvalue and outgrind the opponent through its unique control and lands synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to quickly assemble a game-winning board state. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will to control the game and protect the combo. Additionally, it incorporates cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Teferi, Time Raveler to provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while also having answers to disrupt opponent's strategies.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Show and Tell + Omniscience to put Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play, giving the player a powerful, game-winning threat. The deck includes various ways to find and protect the combo pieces, such as Ponder, Brainstorm, Cunning Wish, and Force of Will. The addition of Lórien Revealed and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential and win the game in a swift and decisive manner.
